title: Lynkk for Sales Teams: Every Call Recorded, Every Follow-up Owned

lines: Back-to-back sales calls. No time to write any of it down.
By Friday, nobody remembers who promised the proposal.
Notes are half typed, follow-ups slip, and every call starts cold.
The Mac app notices Zoom, Meet or Teams, and no bot joins.
After the call, the Meeting Brief has the decisions, the open questions, and action items with an owner and a due date.
Every timestamp plays the moment it was said.
Before the next call, your morning email shows what's still open.
And Ask Lynkk answers from your own notes, with sources.
On the Mac, hold a key and talk. The words land where your cursor is.
Talk to buyers. Lynkk takes the notes.
